liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Nobody's Fault But Mine** (2 reviews): Very cool post-drums run of this song was highlighted in the second set; Guitar interplay comes through very well on this specific recording [17][21]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): Vocals were shaky, but the music was considered good by the reviewer [16]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Excellent performance at a tempo described as neither too fast nor too slow [17]
- **Don't Need Love** (1 review): Described as a bloody awful song, likely played for a bathroom break [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-09-03.sbd.miller.34772.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 131 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1985-09-03.mtx.seamons.94595.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 131 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1985-09-03.Senn421.Darby.119571.Flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 127 min [3]
- **gd1985-09-03.169186.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 134 min [5]
- **gd1985-09-03.148576.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 128 min [7]
- **gd1985-09-03.beyerM160.connor.77197.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 126 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [9]. Said about its sound: High energy performance with strong guitar work, though Jerry struggled with lyrics [16]
- **gd1985-09-03.123078.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 132 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Lacks bass compared to other 1985 shows, but pitch issues are mostly corrected [20]

## Around the show

- Listener left high school early to attend with sister and her boyfriend [18]
- Described as a great nighttime outdoor camping scene that changed the listener's life [18]
- Crowd huddled to smoke during Drums and Space, aided by a friend's supply [26]
- Greeks '85 performance of Cryptical was significantly better than the Starlight show [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-09-03.sbd.miller.34772.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [1]
- **gd1985-09-03.mtx.seamons.94595.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Matrix created by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro from Oade sources; SBD transfer by Jim Keith and Todd Campbell; AUD by Oade Brothers [2]
- **gd1985-09-03.Senn421.Darby.119571.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; Sennheiser MD421's (PAS/LOC Behind Soundboard/6 Feet High)> Sony TC-D5M,Tapes sony Metallic; Transfer Information:Tascam… [3]. Also: Recording credited to Mr. Darby from his collection of master audiences [3]
- **gd1985-09-03.169186.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII-S90) [5]. Also: Oade's Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies a patch in Drums [5]
- **gd1985-09-03.148576.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [7]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source patches crowd, Feel Like A Stranger, and Space [7]
- **gd1985-09-03.beyerM160.connor.77197.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Charlie Connor; transferred by Charlie Connor; source: FOB (Section 2A Row D Seat 8)>(Jim Vita's)Beyer Dynamic M160's>Sony TCD5M(Charlie Connor's CM - TDK MA90's) [9]
- **gd1985-09-03.123078.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [12]
